title: Settling Old Scores
next_chapter_hook: Han Lie retreated in disarray but not before warning: 'You cannot protect them all. Chen Tianming thought the same back then.'

text.content: That gaze from beyond the Three Realms pressed against his back like thorns, yet Chen Ji calmly closed his eyes under the pressure. A moment later, he reopened them, the abyssal scheming in his gaze already concealed, replaced by his usual mild demeanor. Mo Xiansheng's residual soul whispered in his Mental Sea: 'Master of the Tianji Record, you've finally sensed it... this chess game has never been played by you alone.' Chen Ji slightly raised the corner of his lips, a faint smile playing at them: 'I know. But at least for now, the pieces to be cleared from the board, I shall remove myself.' Before the words even faded, his figure had already vanished like a specter into the ruins deep within the Imperial Capital.

Above the eastern ruins of the Imperial Capital, charred walls and debris still bore the marks of the battle from days ago. Sunlight filtered through heavy clouds but could not penetrate the killing intent permeating this dead zone. Three figures descended from different directions, landing before Chen Ji—Ye Qing and her elite Demonic Path warriors. Ye Qing, in her fluttering black dress, radiated lethal allure: 'The locations of three hidden strongholds are locked. The combined forces of former dynasty remnants and old sect allies total 872 personnel, with three half-step Transcendence experts.' Chen Ji stood with hands clasped behind his back, gaze sweeping distant rooftops, lips curving faintly: 'Hard work, Lady Ye Qing. But today's show—I wonder when a certain uninvited guest intends to reveal themselves?'

dialogue.content: Han Lie, why hide and cower? Your Xuanwu Sect's Turtle Breathing Technique may be exceptional, but before me, spare yourself the trouble.

(A赤golden figure stepped out from the Void—it was Han Lie, the number one genius of Xuanwu Sect. His blood qi surged like a rainbow, each step making the earth beneath him tremble. Han Lie gazed at Chen Ji's gentle face, a flash of disgust crossing his eyes) Chen Ji, do you think by climbing into the Demonic Path's favor you can swagger before the three great sects? The Imperial Capital matter is immensely complex—how can atrash servant like you settle accounts?Withdraw now, otherwise—

text.content: Chen Ji did not fly into rage; instead, he laughed softly. His laughter was light, yet格外清晰 in the empty ruins, carrying a spine-chilling composure. 'Otherwise?' He tilted his head, as if genuinely seeking guidance, 'Han brother, do tell, otherwise what? Like in Chapter 778, letting the million soldiers and citizens of the Imperial Capital pay for your arrogance? Or like those three Supreme Elders of your Xuanwu Sect, trapped by the former dynasty remnants' forbidden formation, and finally needing my Tianqing Sect to rescue them?' With each sentence from Chen Ji, Han Lie's expression grew darker. He continued: 'Speaking of which, that night in Chapter 778, where were you, Han Lie? Hiding trembling behind Xuanwu Sect's protective mountain formation? Or had you already negotiated the spoils with the former dynasty remnants?'

dialogue.content: (Han Lie's expression changed drastically, fists clenched tight, blood qi churning like boiling water) Insolent! A mere servant disciple dares to question me? That night's events—my Xuanwu Sect was not at fault! Someone within Tianqing Sect colluded with external enemies, which led to—

(Chen Ji suddenly raised his hand, a golden inscription flying from his sleeve, transforming into a ghostly light screen. The screen displayed footage: on the chaotic night in the Imperial Capital, three black shadows infiltrated Xuanwu Sect's quarters, having a secret meeting with Han Lie for an entire hour) Someone within Tianqing Sect colluded with external enemies? Han brother, are you referring to Sect Master Ling Yuan, or the person in this footage drinking and laughing with the former dynasty remnants—yourself?

text.content: Silence descended upon the ruins. Han Lie's face cycled through green and white hues, never imagining that night's secret meeting had been completely recorded. Ye Qing beside him chuckled: 'Young Master Han, it seems your friendship with the former dynasty remnants runs deeper than even my Demonic Path.' The surrounding Demonic cultivators burst into laughter. Chen Ji remained cloud-like and calm: 'From Chapter 778 until now, three months have passed. In these three months, I've been investigating who truly orchestrated the Imperial Capital turmoil.' He paced forward, gaze sharp as a blade, 'Now the truth is clear—the former dynasty remnants sought to exploit the three sects' internal strife to restore their kingdom, and certain individuals...'

dialogue.content: Certain individuals merely used others as blades, reaping profits while sitting back. They thought by letting the three great sects wear each other down, they could rise in the chaos. Unfortunately, they miscalculated one thing—the One beyond the Three Realms... is not pleased with this chess game.

text.content: Before Chen Ji's words could finish, three earth-shaking explosions echoed from the distance. Ye Qing's eyes lit up: 'The formations on the three hidden strongholds have been dismantled by my people. The combined forces of former dynasty remnants and old sect allies are now collapsing.' Chen Ji gave a slight nod, but his gaze remained fixed on Han Lie: 'Han brother, you arrived at an unfortunate time,正好 catching me settling old scores. According to the rules, which side should you stand on?' Han Lie's mouth twitched, coldly responding: 'Chen Ji, stop your theatrical tricks! What Three Realms beyond, what Tianji Record—it's all just smoke and mirrors!'

Smoke and mirrors? Chen Ji laughed softly, slowly walking toward Han Lie. His steps were measured, each one seeming to measure something, yet carrying an inexplicable, unnameable rhythm. Han Lie instinctively wanted to retreat, only to find his body immobilized by an invisible force. 'Han brother, we've known each other for years.' Chen Ji's voice remained mild, yet profoundly unsettling, 'That night in Chapter 778, when the Imperial Capital burned, what were you doing, Han Lie? I sent people to summon you, but you claimed Xuanwu Sect was too busy. Later, when the Imperial Capital was pacified, you were the first to claim credit, asserting Xuanwu Sect was the main force in quelling the rebellion.'

dialogue.content: (Cold sweat beaded on Han Lie's forehead, yet he forced himself to maintain an air of dominance) So what? The law of the jungle governs the cultivation world! The three great sects have been battling for a century—whose hands aren't stained with debts? You're merely lucky, Chen Ji, climbing the Tianqing Sect ladder and fraternizing with the Demonic Path—

'Lucky?' Chen Ji halted, their eyes locking. 'Han brother speaks correctly—the law of the jungle does govern the cultivation world.' (He suddenly extended his finger, gently pressing it against Han Lie's Brow Center) 'Today, I shall personally teach you what true survival of the fittest means.'

choice.prompt: Chen Ji activates the 'Observer Authority', preparing to teach Han Lie an unforgettable lesson. Facing this former nemesis, how does he intend to handle him?

choices.text: Kill One to Warn a Hundred
choices.description: Completely erase Han Lie's entire lifespan, crushing and deterring all those with ulterior motives through absolute power.
choices.visible_reward: Reputation +20, all forces present witness the fall of Xuanwu Sect's number one genius
choices.risk_hint: This action may completely infuriate Xuanwu Sect, triggering a sect war

dialogue.content: (Han Lie's pupils contracted sharply, feeling an irresistible force spreading from Chen Ji's fingertip—a power beyond his comprehension, the authority of an Observer) No... this is impossible! You're just a mere servant disciple, how can you... Aaaahhh—!

text.content: Brilliant golden light blazed from Chen Ji's fingertip, an invisible law force directly piercing Han Lie's life origin. Han Lie's black hair turned gray in an instant, wrinkles spreading across his face like a spider's web. His originally robust physique rapidly aged, as if ten years of life had been ruthlessly stripped away.

choices.description: Only erase ten breaths of Han Lie's lifespan as a warning, preserving his life but severely weakening his strength.
choices.visible_reward: Han Lie's strength regressed by one minor realm, Xuanwu Sect losing face
choices.risk_hint: Han Lie may bear a grudge and seek revenge in the future

dialogue.content: (Han Lie felt his lifespan recede like the tide. Within ten breaths, his aura suddenly declined by one minor realm. His originally abundant vitality became frail, and even his face aged by several years) You... how dare you...!

text.content: Chen Ji retracted his fingers and casually blew away the nonexistent dust on his fingertips: 'Brother Han, this is the consequence of opposing our Tianqing Sect. Of course, if you feel wronged, feel free to return to Xuanwu Sect for reinforcements.' A mocking arc curled at the corner of his mouth, 'But I am quite curious, after this battle, can you still have a say in the Xuanwu Sect?'

choices.description: Instead of acting personally, hand over the evidence of Han Lie colluding with remnants of the former dynasty to Ye Qing, letting the Demonic Path handle the matter
choices.visible_reward: Han Lie falls into the Demonic Path's hands, life and death beyond his control; Ye Qing's favor +10
choices.risk_hint: The Demonic Path seizes the opportunity to expand influence, potentially nurturing a tiger for future calamity

dialogue.content: (Ye Qing takes the image engraving from Chen Ji, her gaze meaningfully examining Han Lie) Young Master Han, I have long heard your name. They say your Xuanwu Sect's protective mountain formation is unmatched under heaven—I wonder if it can withstand our Demonic Path's 'Bone Corroding Soul Dissolving Technique'?

text.content: Chen Ji stands with hands behind his back, stepping back to cede the stage to Ye Qing: 'Brother Han, Miss Ye Qing is the Holy Maiden of the Demonic Holy Sect. Do have a good chat with her. I still have matters to attend to, so I will not keep you company.' His tone is dismissive, as if Han Lie's fate no longer concerns him

No matter what Chen Ji's choice, Han Lie's destiny has been completely rewritten at this moment. Upon the ruins, that once domineering crimson-gold figure appears disheveled and wretched. He struggles to steady himself, only to find his cultivation has fallen from half-step Transcendence to Nascent Soul Peak, still continuously declining. The sneering laughter of surrounding Demonic Path cultivators stabs into his ears like needles, and the gazes of those 'servant disciples' and 'waste' he once despised have become the humiliation he can least bear

dialogue.content: (Han Lie clenches his teeth, words emerging word by word) Chen Ji... remember this! Today's humiliation, I will repay a hundredfold tomorrow! You cannot protect everyone, just as Chen Tianming could not protect those around him back then! His fate will be your fate!

text.content: Chen Tianming. These three characters struck like thunder, exploding above the ruins. Ye Qing's pupils slightly constricted, as she keenly sensed the weight behind this name. Chen Ji's originally calm and carefree expression finally rippled with emotion, something slowly burning in the depths of those perpetually smiling eyes. However, the next moment, he had restored his usual gentle appearance, only the smile was several degrees colder than before. 'Brother Han, you know quite a lot.' He slowly spoke, 'But I advise you, before saying such words, think about your own situation first.'

The words fell, and Chen Ji flicked his sleeve. An invisible force lifted Han Lie and hurled him hundreds of zhang away. Mid-air, Han Lie tumbled several somersaults before miserably crashing into a pile of debris in the distance, drenched in blood, utterly wretched. He struggled to rise from the ruins, turning back to fix Chen Ji with a gaze filled with bone-deep hatred and unwillingness. Yet Chen Ji no longer looked at him, only standing with hands behind his back, gazing at the gradually dissipating smoke above the imperial capital, his voice light: 'Today's settlement ends here. If any of the three great powers still feels aggrieved, they are welcome to come discuss with me.'

Han Lie staggers to his feet, wiping the blood from the corner of his mouth, and fixes Chen Ji with one final fierce glare. He does not utter another狠话, only burying that distorted face deep into the shadows. When that crimson-gold figure completely vanishes from view, Ye Qing quietly speaks: 'Chen Gongzi, Han Lie is narrow-minded and will seek revenge for the slightest grievance. Today you let him go, but I fear he will become a great trouble in the future.' Chen Ji turns around, smiling faintly: 'Miss Ye Qing worries too much. He is merely a跳梁小丑, and I have my own calculations.' His gaze passes over the ruins of the imperial capital toward the distant direction of Tianqing Sect, and in the depths of his eyes lies a profundity even Ye Qing cannot fathom

The gaze from beyond the three realms still prickles like芒在背, and Chen Ji knows clearly that today's settlement of old accounts is merely a small move in the chess game, the true game has just begun. Yet that name—Chen Tianming—casually mentioned by Han Lie, stirs a long-unfamiliar ripple in Chen Ji's heart. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul sighs幽幽 in the Mental Sea: 'Inheritor of the Tianji Record, you have finally begun to touch those sealed truths... But at the end of this path, is it breaking the局, or another abyss?' Chen Ji offers no answer, only gazing at the darkening twilight on the horizon, a light in his eyes that no one else can comprehend. The winds and clouds over the imperial capital have just begun
